verdict.rationale: Stripe documents sending stablecoins to any external crypto wallet via Global Payouts, and Connect stablecoin payouts in USDC to connected accounts that link a wallet (a stored recipient), with Stripe handling conversion and payout. A community report adds that Connect crypto payouts are limited to individual or sole-proprietor recipients. The evidence never shows the API request flow or any payout status lifecycle through to on-chain settlement. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for wallet-address payouts, documented payout status tracking or events to final settlement, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send stablecoin payouts programmatically — pay a wallet address or stored recipient through the API with documented status tracking to final settlement

citations.quote: Global Payouts: Send stablecoins to any external crypto wallet.
Stablecoin payouts let your Connect platform make payouts in stablecoins, starting with USDC. Your platform balance stays in fiat currency, while Stripe handles conversion and payout.
After a user links a crypto wallet in the Express Dashboard, they immediately see a new USDC balance on their connected account.
Stablecoins in Treasury (Public preview): Receive, store, and send funds globally with stablecoins in your Stripe Financial Account.
